{{Top|leg}}
'''"Watto Steals You Blind"''' was one of the dozens of songs written by a [[Unidentified young new recruit|promising Jedi recruit]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It featured in a songbook specifically created to remind [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of his homeworld. It was a song about [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], Anakin's former master, and his dubious sale practices.
